FEAT-1-STORY-112.title: Execute vector-based provider search
FEAT-1-STORY-112.description: Implement and validate the core provider search execution using MongoDB Atlas vector search, including embedding query generation and top-K provider retrieval.

FEAT-1-STORY-113.title: Implement taxonomy fallback search
FEAT-1-STORY-113.description: Ensure fallback to NUCC taxonomy-based search when vector search confidence is insufficient, including correct specialty code mapping and result merging.

FEAT-1-STORY-114.title: Apply location filtering and geographic resolution
FEAT-1-STORY-114.description: Implement filtering by state, city, and county using FIPS-to-county mapping and multi-stage geographic narrowing to ensure relevant local provider results.

FEAT-1-STORY-115.title: Unit tests for provider search service logic
FEAT-1-STORY-115.description: Create unit tests covering vector search execution, taxonomy fallback triggering, and location filtering to validate correctness across edge cases.
